name: sentry
description: Manage who belongs to a Sentry organization and its teams; read a release's new issues and the errors after a deploy
author: actionplatform
needs: env: AP_SENTRY_ORG, AP_SENTRY_TOKEN, AP_SENTRY_URL on a machine (the plugin's options on the platform)
net: sentry.io, or the self-hosted Sentry's url
